methodology: Async endpoints; per-request async DI factories; dict inputs to response models; equivalent valid JSON payloads. One worker, asyncio, h11, no lifespan/access logs. Closed-loop stdlib threaded client validates every status/body/content-type. Latencies include client validation and errors; connection establishment is included. ASGI baseline performs valid-input work without framework validation. Loopback throughput is client/machine dependent, not an isolated framework-overhead or production capacity measurement.
